Step into the secret world of Leann Cassidy — a seemingly perfect wife with desires she can no longer ignore. Behind closed doors, Leann is anything but innocent… and you're about to find out just how far her sins can go.

👠 Gorgeous HQ renders
🗣️ Fully voiced dialogues

🔥 A seductive story filled with temptation, lust, and forbidden thrills

notes.title: 🖼️ Our 3D Artist 🖼️
notes.notes:
We’re proud to introduce the talented 3D artist behind the stunning visuals of Leann Sins — Max Smeagol. As the original creator of Leann’s story and a seasoned 3D artist with years of experience, Max has crafted countless adult erotic comic series that are as imaginative as they are visually striking.

His work brings passion, emotion, and intensity to every render — and we’re deeply thankful for his generous contribution to this project.

If you’d like to explore more of his amazing work and support the artist who helped make Leann Sins possible, be sure to check out his pages:
